SAGE Unlocked v1.9.5 (formerly C&C FPS Unlocker)
https://github.com/TheeHorse/SAGE-Unlocked

Copy the 3 files from your game's folder next to the game's exe:

  Red Alert 3         "Red Alert 3"                   ->  <RA3>\Data\
  RA3 Uprising        "Red Alert 3"                   ->  <Uprising>\Data\
  Tiberium Wars 1.10  "Tiberium Wars + Kane's Wrath"  ->  <TW>\RetailExe\1.10\
  Tiberium Wars 1.9   "Tiberium Wars + Kane's Wrath"  ->  <TW>\RetailExe\1.9\   (mods)
  Kane's Wrath 1.3    "Tiberium Wars + Kane's Wrath"  ->  <KW>\RetailExe\1.3\
  Kane's Wrath 1.02   "Tiberium Wars + Kane's Wrath"  ->  <KW>\RetailExe\1.2\    (mods, EA app)
  BFME2 (new)         "Battle for Middle-earth II"    ->  <BFME2>\   (next to game.dat)
  RotWK (new)         "Battle for Middle-earth II"    ->  <RotWK>\   (next to game.dat)

Then start the game like normal.

Linux (Steam Proton): same files, same folders. No launch option, no protontricks.

BFME: the All In One Launcher / Competitive Arena delete these files from the game folder.
Start the game with lotrbfme2.exe / lotrbfme2ep1.exe, or copy the files back after.

Coming from v1.6? Clear the old Steam launch option or delete the old RA3HighFps.exe
in the game folder, otherwise the old version patches first and the new fixes don't run.

Change fps in SAGEUnlocked.ini, or copy one from "FPS presets".
To uninstall, delete the files.

Not working? Send me SAGEUnlocked.log and RA3HighFps.log if there is one (next to the game's exe, or in %TEMP%) or open an issue on GitHub.

GPL v3. Not affiliated with EA.
